stages.label: Forward computation
stages.narrative: GPUs divide the training workload and exchange data within each rack.

stages.label: Backward pass
stages.narrative: GPUs calculate learning updates. Waiting between pipeline stages adds time.

stages.label: Collective synchronization
stages.narrative: The selected collective exchanges updates between racks; the slowest worker holds up the group.

stages.label: Thermal & MFU settlement
stages.narrative: Cooling carries away heat. Insufficient flow caps the modeled clock speed and slows computation.

seeds.label: 256-GPU 3D Parallelism (TP=8, PP=4, DP=8)
seeds.description: Dense transformer 70B training with Ring-AllReduce across 32 racks.

seeds.label: Degraded Node Straggler Cascade
seeds.description: Throttled GPU in Rack R2-4 introduces a tail-latency barrier across all 32 racks.

seeds.label: Cooling flow loss
seeds.description: Facility coolant flow drops 50%; temperature determines whether the modeled thermal clock cap activates.

seeds.label: Double-Binary Tree AllReduce
seeds.description: Tree-based collective reduction optimizing inter-rack latency over raw ring bandwidth.
